# DZ16 hardware test guidance

Before changing DZ16 tests or interpreting their run evidence, consult the [DZ16 gotchas](../../.agents/skills/interactive-hardware-tests/references/dz16-gotchas.md) reference. Do not generalize those version- or board-specific findings to other hardware or firmware.
